```python
# test_slugify.py
import pytest

from your_module import slugify


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input_text", "expected"),
    [
        ("Hello World", "hello-world"),
        ("HELLO WORLD", "hello-world"),
        ("Hello", "hello"),
        ("hello world again", "hello-world-again"),
        ("Hello  World", "hello--world"),  # preserves repeated spaces
        (" Hello World ", "-hello-world-"),  # preserves leading/trailing spaces as hyphens
        ("hello-world", "hello-world"),
        ("", ""),
        ("123 ABC!", "123-abc!"),
    ],
)
def test_slugify(input_text, expected):
    assert slugify(input_text) == expected
```

Replace `your_module` with the name of the Python file containing `slugify`, without the `.py` extension. Run with:

```bash
pytest
```
